scope: Optional x86 research against an explicit Microsoft-signed OCX in task scratch; no registration, installation, product input, or required CTest dependency.

module.activation: Direct DllGetClassObject plus public IOleObject/IPersistStreamInit in a self-owned native host

TreeView.result: attached=1; inserting a self-owned probe node yields count=1. A byte-identical COMCTL32 module renamed away from COMCTL32.OCX leaves TreeViewWndClass attached=0.

Slider.result: The old class has a stable creation-time contract and remains attached=1; the self-owned range/position probe reads back 12. A byte-identical COMCTL32 module renamed away from COMCTL32.OCX leaves SliderWndClass attached=0. Slider20's same public messages become valid after activation but its creation-time geometry is not stable, so it is explicitly asserted attached=0 rather than added through a late existing-window scan.

TabStrip.result: native count is 1. An initial renderer experiment changed it to 0, so TabStrip admission was removed and remains native.

ProgressBar.result: range is 0..30000 and position is 0, but GETSTATE returns 0 rather than a documented PBST state. It remains native; no state/color behavior is guessed.

Toolbar.result: The old COMCTL32.OCX wrapper hosts a native child rather than exposing toolbar messages on its wrapper. A self-owned two-button text-only probe remains attached=1, count=2 and retains checked state. The wrapper reports pre=1, item=2 and post=1 custom-draw stages only after its default route. A byte-identical module renamed away from COMCTL32.OCX is attached=0 and receives no item/post stages. The renderer is limited to text-only ordinary/check buttons; image-list, separator, drop-down, owner-draw and unsupported style variants remain native.

ListView.old_structure: COMCTL32.OCX wrapper -> native SysHeader32; report View property set before activation
ListView.result: The old wrapper only delivers prepaint (pre=1, item=0, post=0) and its native header is created after the outer ListView WM_CREATE boundary; the current creation transaction correctly rejects the outer wrapper rather than performing a late scan or half-install. The separately created old native SysHeader32 remains attached through the existing header path. The new wrapper's header is private and remains native.

StatusBar.public_contract: SB_GETPARTS returns 2 on both observed wrappers
StatusBar.result: Both are OCX-owned wrappers rather than native StatusBarWindow32 children. A parent observer sees no NM_CUSTOMDRAW stage on either wrapper (pre=0, item=0, post=0), so both remain native.

COMCT232-and-COMCT332.public_activation: Direct DllGetClassObject/IOleObject host against UpDown, Animation and CoolBar coclasses
COMCT232-and-COMCT332.result: ComCt232 UpDown is UpDownWndClass and Animation is AnimationWndClass, each directly under CtlFrameWork_ReflectWindow with no native msctls_updown32/animation child. ComCt332 CoolBar activates through ThunderRT6UserControlDC container windows. These are OCX/VB-owned renderers, not standard common-control aliases, so existing UpDown/toolbar painters are not applied.

MaskEdBox.public_contract: USER standard EDIT superclass; WM_SETTEXT/WM_GETTEXT and EM_SETSEL/EM_GETSEL
MaskEdBox.result: The existing standard EDIT path attaches=1. The direct self-owned probe writes and reads 12/34, then selects and reads back 1:4. A byte-identical module renamed away from MSMASK32.OCX has the same attachment and round trips, which is expected because admission follows the USER superclass contract rather than a guessed OCX filename. Existing bounded EDIT presentation is therefore applicable; mask parsing/validation/formatting remain with the native control.

DataGrid.public_contract: No stable standard-control or public drawing contract was observed on the outer OCX window; its final style is a custom child client surface (0x56800000).
DataGrid.result: An OCX can transiently request frame bits while it constructs its outer window. The creation path now rejects a generic child frame whose registered class belongs to an external module unless an existing exact public protocol admits it. The native probe asserts DataGridWndClass attached=0; its USER32 ScrollBar child remains attached=1 through the ordinary standard-control path and its position can be set/read as 12. This prevents a stale frame attachment without scanning or introspecting OCX private state.

External-OCX-boundaries.RichTextBox: RichTextWndClass from RICHTX32.OCX is an OCX-owned custom client surface and remains attached=0.
External-OCX-boundaries.SSTab: SSTabCtlWndClass from TABCTL32.OCX is an OCX-owned custom client surface and remains attached=0.
External-OCX-boundaries.FlatScrollBar: FlatSB20WndClass from MSCOMCT2.OCX is an OCX-owned custom client surface and remains attached=0.
External-OCX-boundaries.MonthView-and-DTPicker: MonthView20WndClass and DTPicker20WndClass from MSCOMCT2.OCX are OCX-owned custom client surfaces and remain attached=0.
External-OCX-boundaries.Old-UpDown: UpDownWndClass from COMCT232.OCX is an OCX-owned wrapper, not a native msctls_updown32 child, and remains attached=0.
External-OCX-boundaries.FlexGrid-and-Chart: MSFlexGridWndClass, MSHFlexGridWndClass, and MSChart20WndClass are OCX-owned custom client surfaces and remain attached=0 in the inert direct-OLE host; no grid/chart data or methods were invoked.
External-OCX-boundaries.Direct-inplace-sweep: The current published x86 ntw16s32.dll was injected into a self-owned direct-OLE host and activated official RICHTX32.OCX RichTextBox, TABCTL32.OCX SSTab, MSFLXGRD.OCX MSFlexGrid, MSHFLXGD.OCX MSHFlexGrid, and MSCHRT20.OCX MSChart. The observed classes were respectively CtlFrameWork_ReflectWindow -> RichTextWndClass, SSTabCtlWndClass, MSFlexGridWndClass, MSHFlexGridWndClass, and MSChart20WndClass; every observed client surface reported attached=0 and protocol_bound=0. This is affirmative evidence to preserve each private renderer, not a general class-name exclusion or an assertion about unrelated component versions.
External-OCX-boundaries.Dialog-and-nonvisual-hosts: CmDialogWndClass, MSCommWndClass, MSWINSCKWndClass, AdodcWndClass, mapiSesWndClass, and mapiMsgWndClass are OCX-owned windows and remain attached=0. The probe performed only InitNew/in-place activation; it did not show a dialog, open a port, connect a socket, set a data source, or log on to MAPI. The current-package MSComm/Winsock/MAPI sweep confirms no standard child HWND or public content-neutral draw route.
External-OCX-boundaries.Data-bound-standard-children: DBComboWndClass and DataComboWndClass expose a USER32 Edit child; DataListWndClass and DataGridWndClass expose a USER32 ScrollBar child. Each outer OCX window remains attached=0 while the observed standard child remains attached=1. With the current published x86 DLL, the self-owned host writes and reads Edit text alpha plus selection 1:4, and sets/reads the ScrollBar position 12. DBListWndClass exposes no standard child in the same inert host. This is bounded reuse of an existing renderer, not a claim to style data binding, lists, grids, or any OCX-owned drawing.
External-OCX-boundaries.Data-bound-private-surfaces: The same inert current-package probe observes DBListWndClass, AdodcWndClass, DataRepeaterWndClass, and rdcWndClass as OCX-owned client surfaces with attached=0 and protocol_bound=0, and no standard child HWND. It performs no connection, query, source assignment, reporting, or data operation; preserve those outer controls natively.
External-OCX-boundaries.SysInfo-Inet-PictureClip: The direct x86 OLE host activates SysInfoWndClass, MSINETWndClass, and PicClipWndClass from the official OCXs. Each outer OCX client surface remains attached=0 and exposes no observed standard child HWND or public custom-draw contract. Preserve native behavior; do not infer that type-library OLEMISC visibility alone proves a safe styling route.
External-OCX-boundaries.MMControl: MCI32.OCX creates an outer mciWndClass and nine USER32 Button children. Every observed Button has low style 0x000B (BS_OWNERDRAW), remains attached=0, and is owned by the private mciWndClass surface. Do not route these through generic BUTTON painting: that would replace the OCX's WM_DRAWITEM contract without a public owner/drawing protocol.

verification: x86 direct OLE host through candidate run16s; exact owner/reflector, attachment state and public-message round trips recorded.
